sentences.text: Graffiti is the third studio album by American recording artist Chris Brown .	Chris Brown	Chris Brown	studio album	studio album	recording artist	recording artist
It was released on December 7 , 2009 , by Jive Records .	Jive	Jive Records	Jive Records	Jive Records
The album serves as a follow-up to his previous album Exclusive -LRB- 2007 -RRB- .	Exclusive	Exclusive (Chris Brown album)

Recording sessions took place from 2008 to 2009 , with these several record producers , including Polow da Don , Swizz Beatz , The Runners and Brian Kennedy , among others .	Swizz Beatz	Swizz Beatz	Brian Kennedy	Brian Kennedy (producer)	The Runners	The Runners	Polow da Don	Polow da Don
Primarily an R&B and pop outing , Graffiti incorporates elements of hip hop music with synthesizers .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	pop	Pop music	hip hop music	hip hop music
The album debuted at number 7 on the US Billboard 200 , selling 102,489 copies in its first week .
To date , `` Graffiti '' has sold 341,000 copies in the United States .

The album became his third consecutive top-ten debut in the United States following Exclusive in 2007 , while producing two singles that has achieved moderate chart success .	Exclusive	Exclusive (Chris Brown album)
Upon its release , Graffiti received generally negative reviews from most music critics .

Graffiti was nominated for two Grammy Awards ; including one for the Best Contemporary R&B Album and the other for the Best R&B Performance by a Duo or Group with Vocals for this track , `` Take My Time '' featuring Tank .
